topic: How does dual-mode feeding (TEM/TE1) influence power allocation and payload thermal management in multi-beam systems?
consensus_response: Dual-mode feeding (TEM/TE1) introduces intermodulation distortion, impacting signal quality and capacity. It enables flexible power allocation between beams but also increases inter-beam interference, degrading spectral efficiency. The trade-off between power allocation flexibility and reduced Average Satisfaction Index (ASI) comes at a cost of degraded signal quality and reduced spectral efficiency. Adaptive modulation and coding (AMC) can adapt to changing channel conditions but interacts with TEM/TE1 feeding, potentially degrading signal quality.
reference_context: Dual-mode feeding in multi-beam systems introduces intermodulation distortion, impacting signal quality and capacity. The trade-off between power allocation flexibility and reduced ASI comes at a cost of degraded signal quality and reduced spectral efficiency.
